# Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSAMDIO)

> Rotaract South Asia MDIO is a regional group of member districts formed to disseminate information and facilitate communication among Rotaract clubs across 8 nations, and to support leadership learning and multidistrict programs.

RSAMDIO is Rotary International's recognized Multi-District Information Organization for Rotaract in South Asia. It is not a governing body for districts or clubs.

- Home: https://rsamdio.org/
- About: https://rsamdio.org/about
